### Jesus Goes to the Untouchable
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/jesus-goes-to-the-untouchable-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 8:2-3
Points:
- The leper endured severe pain and social isolation, yet boldly approached Jesus in humble faith.
- He recognized Jesus' divine authority to heal while submitting entirely to His sovereign will.
- Jesus reached out and touched an outcast, showing His willingness to enter our brokenness.
- Christ's immediate physical healing of the man points to the immediate spiritual cleansing He offers from sin.
- Jesus instructed him to follow the law's restoration process so he could return to his community.

### A God Who Is Willing
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/a-god-who-is-willing-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Luke 5:13
Points:
- Jesus' words and touch to the leper demonstrate God's deep desire and willingness to heal.
- Even when healing is not experienced as hoped, believers are called to trust God's higher ways.
- Jesus never turned away those who came to Him, revealing the Father's heart.
- God's willingness to restore does not depend on human merit, earned status, or favoritism.
- Believers should maintain faith in God's saving and healing character regardless of difficult circumstances.
